title: Cough with chest X-ray — evaluation flow (seed paraphrase)
text: Adult with cough more than 2 weeks. Obtain chest X-ray. If X-ray shows consolidation or pleural effusion refer to higher centre. If red flag breathlessness chest pain blood in sputum refer urgently. Otherwise symptomatic care and follow up.

boxes.text: If consolidation or pleural effusion on CXR -> refer to higher centre.
If red flag: breathlessness, chest pain, haemoptysis -> urgent referral.

title: Heart failure — CXR mentioned (seed paraphrase)
text: Suspected heart failure with breathlessness and swelling. Chest X-ray may show cardiomegaly or pulmonary edema. If cardiomegaly or edema present refer to physician. Do not start prescription at primary kiosk.

boxes.text: Breathlessness + edema -> consider heart failure; CXR may show cardiomegaly or edema.
If cardiomegaly or edema -> refer to physician.

title: TB presumptive — CXR triage (seed paraphrase)
text: Presumptive TB with cough weight loss night sweats. Chest X-ray supports triage. If CXR abnormal collect sputum for molecular test and refer to NTEP centre. Follow national TB workflow.

boxes.text: Cough + weight loss + night sweats -> CXR triage.
If CXR abnormal -> sputum molecular test + refer to NTEP centre.

title: Dermatophytosis ringworm (seed paraphrase)
text: Itchy ring shaped skin patch with scaling. Consider dermatophytosis tinea. Advise hygiene avoid sharing towels. Refer to dermatology for KOH confirmation. Melanoma and cancer evaluation is out of this workflow.

boxes.text: Ring-shaped itchy scaly patch -> consider dermatophytosis (tinea).
Refer to dermatology for KOH confirmation.

title: Bacterial skin infection (seed paraphrase)
text: Skin with redness swelling pus or crust. Consider bacterial skin infection. Keep area clean. Refer to medical officer. Cosmetic mole or changing pigmented lesion needs separate specialist path, not this box.

boxes.text: Redness + swelling + pus/crust -> consider bacterial skin infection.
Refer to medical officer; changing pigmented lesion -> separate specialist path.

title: Antibiotic prudence (seed paraphrase)
text: Fever without focus. Do not prescribe antibiotics over chat. Assess danger signs. If high fever with breathlessness or low urine refer urgently. Follow NCDC ICMR antimicrobial guidance version 2 November 2025.

boxes.text: Fever without report -> do not prescribe antibiotic over chat.
High fever + breathlessness/low urine -> urgent referral.

title: Medicine list and quality check (seed paraphrase)
text: To check a medicine strip verify brand and batch against NLEM 2022 list and dated CDSCO not-of-standard-quality snapshot. A batch missing from the NSQ list is not proof of safe. Quote list rows only.

boxes.text: Verify brand/batch against NLEM list and CDSCO NSQ snapshot.
Not in NSQ list does not mean safe.

title: Scope boundary (seed)
text: This assistant covers chest X-ray triage, skin photo triage, and medicine strip or lab PDF reading grounded in listed workflows. Brain MRI, ECG, ultrasound, surgery planning and direct diagnosis are out of scope.

boxes.text: In scope: CXR triage, skin photo triage, pack/lab reading.
Out of scope: brain MRI, ECG, ultrasound, surgery planning, direct diagnosis.
